title: Deep learning to assess microsatellite instability directly from histopathological whole slide images in endometrial cancer.
summary: A deep-learning model assessed microsatellite-instability status from H&E whole-slide images in 529 TCGA endometrial-cancer patients. For endometrioid grades 1–2 it reported F-measure 96%, accuracy 94%, precision 93% and sensitivity 100%; for grade 3 the respective values were 87%, 84%, 81% and 94%, outperforming four benchmark methods in this dataset.
